body.statement: Fix \(\mathcal A\). Let two finite temporal-role semi-Markovian SCMs have observed role values in this same family, legal lags bounded by \(L\), a common strictly positive rational observed role law, unequal distributions of the designated outcome role under intervention on the designated treatment role, and an acyclic union of lag-zero coordinate relations. The independent-shift product construction yields \(M_0,M_1\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\) with \(P_{M_0}=P_{M_1}\) as measures on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\) and \(\theta_{M_0}(y;x)\ne\theta_{M_1}(y;x)\); independent auxiliary edge channels valued in the fixed alphabets make both summaries exactly \(H\) without changing the separation.
body.justification: This lemma turns a bounded graphical collision into the whole-process stationary countermodels required for semantic nonidentification.
body.gap: Shpitser--Pearl construct finite fixed-ADMG hedge models, while Jahn--Karnik--Schulman localize fixed-graph hedges; neither result preserves strict stationarity, time homogeneity, exact summaries, and equality of the entire process law under a refinement switch.
body.consumer: Every rejecting state of \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)\) obtains an auditable finite countermodel on the fixed product alphabet rather than an inconclusive failure code.
